raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Expose the existing fastsafetensors buffered/GDS selection as the boolean
`fastsafetensors_nogds` model-loader option. Preserve defaults and reject
explicit GDS for initialized multi-rank WORLD before CUDA setup.

## Claims

- `--load-format fastsafetensors --model-loader-extra-config '{"fastsafetensors_nogds": true}'`
  selects existing buffered transfers. Explicit `false` requests existing
  single-rank GDS; omission preserves existing selection.
- Reject non-booleans, use with other load formats, and explicit GDS in a
  multi-rank WORLD group.
- Retain queue-depth control and pre-first-yield unsupported-GDS fallback.
  No startup, steady-state CPU/inference speed or guaranteed-GDS-use claim.

## Validation

This draft is for author review. Commit `d3ab03721` integrates the exact reviewed
patch on main `887eef12e`. Its stable patch ID is unchanged and
`git diff --check` passed. No new current-main native build, model run or hosted
Buildkite pass is claimed.

Accepted selected runtime evidence used Python/test source `2fab35893` and
retained native extensions from `2b08392a5`, not a full rebuild of the current
target:

| Coverage | Result | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Configuration/rank safety | 10 passed | Invalid types/formats and a real two-rank Gloo WORLD rejection. |
| Tensor loading | 6 passed | Omitted/true/false at queue depths 0/1; exact names, dtype, shape and tensor values against safetensors. |
| GPT-2 generation | 3 passed | The three modes through real `vllm_runner` weights; nonempty output, not token/quality parity. |

Pinned offline inputs, current fixtures and read-only dependency support were
used in the retained `pytest.main` runs. Two scoped text checks also passed;
this is not a full hook/suite result. Raw internal logs are not attached, and
actual GDS use on the validation filesystem is not established.

Portable reproduction/CI equivalent from `tests/` in a supported environment
with the patched package and model access:

```bash
../.venv/bin/python -m pytest -v -s -p pytest_timeout \
  model_executor/model_loader/fastsafetensors_loader/test_weight_utils.py \
  model_executor/model_loader/fastsafetensors_loader/test_fastsafetensors_loader.py \
  --timeout=900 --timeout-method=thread
```

This is not a claim that the shell command ran verbatim in the retained
selected-case experiments. The added L4 Buildkite step selects both modules,
with explicit source dependencies, spawn, fault handling and the watchdog.
Existing applicable AMD selection remains; neither hosted route is claimed
passed. A draft/push does not automatically trigger full upstream Buildkite.

## Details

The existing iterator already chooses buffered transfers for multi-rank groups
and GDS otherwise. Users could not explicitly select buffered transfer without
changing that policy. Pass a validated optional boolean from the existing
loader to its iterator instead of adding a loader or changing defaults.

Explicit `false` cannot override multi-rank safety: GDS setup may initialize
CUDA contexts on visible GPUs. The initialized global WORLD group, not only TP
size, is the relevant boundary. This is load-time/library-lifetime selection;
it adds no steady-state inference work or new transfer/teardown mechanism.
Multi-rank users already buffered by default do not gain a new buffered mode.

Related [PR55985](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55985) adds automatic
memory-budget/chunk planning and associated transfer decisions. This change is
the smaller manual boolean selector, without that planner or dependency-floor
change; the overlapping loader code requires coordination, not a claim of zero
related work. [PR51554](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51554) concerns
a separate sharded-state loader.

Modernization review found no justified CUDA/architecture-specific rewrite for
this mode selector. Existing pipeline, fallback and close behavior are reused.
AI assistance was used in implementation and review preparation. Human review,
accurate attribution and the confirmed NVIDIA-email DCO remain explicit.
The human submitter confirmed line-by-line review before opening this draft;
it remains draft for further author/design review.

+  - >-

 # Disabled until the apt packages installation is locked.
 # - label: ":nvidia: (H200 MIG 35GB) Model Executor"
 #   device: h200_35gb

@@ -4,3 +4,23 @@ Loading model weights with fastsafetensors
 Using fastsafetensors library enables loading model weights to GPU memory by leveraging GPU direct storage. See [their GitHub repository](https://github.com/foundation-model-stack/fastsafetensors) for more details.
 
 To enable this feature, use the `--load-format fastsafetensors` command-line argument
+
+To use buffered transfers without GPU Direct Storage, pass
+`--model-loader-extra-config '{"fastsafetensors_nogds": true}'`. The option accepts
+only a boolean and only with `--load-format fastsafetensors`. When omitted, the
+existing default is unchanged: buffered transfers for process groups larger
+than one, and GDS otherwise.
+
+An explicit `false` requests the existing GDS path for a single-rank process
+group. It is rejected for a multi-rank process group, before selecting a CUDA
+device or starting the loader: GDS can initialize CUDA contexts on every visible
+GPU and cause memory failures. Group size is taken from the initialized global
+process group, not just the tensor-parallel setting. This preserves the existing
+multi-rank safety policy instead of silently ignoring `false`.
+
+The existing fallback to buffered transfers on an unsupported-GDS error before
+any weight is yielded still applies. `VLLM_FASTSAFETENSORS_QUEUE_SIZE` continues
+to control the existing loader's pipeline depth. This option only selects a mode
+of the existing fastsafetensors library; it does not add a loader, change
+steady-state inference or guarantee a startup/CPU speedup. No saving is implied
+for multi-rank deployments that already use buffered transfers by default.

+def _reject_multirank_gds(rank, rendezvous):
+    torch.distributed.init_process_group(
+        "gloo",
+        init_method=rendezvous,
+        rank=rank,
+        world_size=2,
+        timeout=timedelta(seconds=30),
+    )
+    try:
+        config = LoadConfig(
+            load_format="fastsafetensors",
+            model_loader_extra_config={"fastsafetensors_nogds": False},

+        assert torch.distributed.get_world_size() == 2

+        ):

+    finally:
+        torch.distributed.destroy_process_group()
+
+
